newsitem.title: THAILAND: Car-theft gang working from Thai prison uncovered.
newsitem.headline: Car-theft gang working from Thai prison uncovered.

text.p: Thai police said on Tuesday they had uncovered a car-theft ring operating from a prison after seizing two stolen cars from a prisoner and a prison employee outside the jail.

The two suspects, including the prisoner who was supposed to have been confined in the Klongprem jail on car theft charges, then led police to another prisoner and the employee believed to be part of the ring.

Arthit Phothong, governor of the prison on the outskirts of Bangkok, initially defied police requests to search the prison for evidence. But he later said the implicated prisoners had been allowed to do public service outside the prison because of good behaviour.

An angry Deputy Interior Minister Chaipak Siriwat said he had ordered a probe into the debacle. "I have ordered an investigation into the case and will punish everyone found involved in the crimes," he told reporters.
